data.long_meaning: Asirvas is derived from the Sanskrit words 'asi' which means fearless and 'rvas' meaning one who is without fear. It is a name that embodies courage, bravery, and fearlessness. The name Asirvas carries the meaning “Fearless, without fear” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asirvas usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, without fear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
